provenance.note: Icon-eligible tree items: [name, use_type, picture_index], in the EXACT order scripts/build-icon-map.mjs's loadTreeIconItems() collects them — base-game data/trees/*.json files FIRST (each file's buildings[] then units_techs[], concatenated), THEN chronicles/data/trees/*.json — because build-icon-map.mjs (and pipeline/crates/refdata/src/icon_map.rs, which mirrors it) resolves a (use_type, slugified-name) collision by keeping the FIRST item seen, so THIS ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING; do not re-sort. Unlike aoe2techtree-tree-nodes.json (unit-tech-names' base-game-only, node_id-keyed slice), this DELIBERATELY INCLUDES chronicles/data/trees for maximum icon coverage — icon-map keys purely by slugified display name, never by game id, so a chronicles-only name simply adds its own slug rather than colliding with a base-game one. Items already exclude node_status "NotAvailable" entries (build-icon-map.mjs's own collectIconItems filter, applied before this slice existed). Regenerate by re-fetching data/trees/*.json + chronicles/data/trees/*.json at the SHA (scripts/build-icon-map.mjs --refresh writes the equivalent .cache/aoe2-data/tree-icon-items.json this slice was cut from).
